description.html: HabiStat Pure Calcium is a pure, natural source of calcium in the form of calcium carbonate, with added vitamins A, D3 and E. The manufacturer says it is easily digested by reptiles and amphibians. The 125 g pot seals tightly, so the powder stays dry and loose.

Calcium is the key mineral for bones and muscles. HabiStat stresses that an animal can only use dietary calcium if it has proper UVB lighting, dietary vitamin D3 or a combination of both, so Pure Calcium does not replace a UVB lamp.

Manufacturer's instructions: lightly dust all insects or vegetation at every feed; a quarter of a teaspoon is enough. Make sure all insects are coated and feed them immediately. The powder can also be sprinkled on vegetables and meat. Avoid inhaling the dust and store in a cool, dry place.
For species that need more calcium, such as juveniles and breeding females, HabiStat also recommends a calcium dish in the terrarium. Find other supplements in our equipment range.

All equipment can be ordered by phone or WhatsApp message. Courier delivery across Serbia, in-person pickup in Novi Sad. For questions about the product, compatibility or recommendations for your animal - get in touch.
